'''Tarklan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]] member of the [[Specialists]] employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Along with the other Specialists, he was killed by the Imperial forces.
